title: F1 Polish: implementation summary undercounts skipped tests
detail: The implementation report says one skipped case; its five original suite logs and the independent rerun total eleven skips (4 design, 4 release acceptance, 1 dispatch, 1 delivery, 1 laws). The seven affected entrance tests ran; hosted CI at the candidate succeeds. No demonstrated product harm or unmet value criterion. See skip-evidence.json.
fix: Use the corrected eleven-skip count and explicit unavailable-evidence limits in this validation report; no product change required.
